_readme: A narrative = an itinerary through the items. Each narrative has an 'order' array of ids (from items.json) that defines prev/next.
The same item can appear in more than one narrative, even in a different order.
'timeline' is the required historical narrative: it is currently populated with the order of the item list from the project document as a placeholder,
to be corrected with the real chronology (Renzi's life/career dates) before submission.
The second narrative is still to be decided as a group (see ARCHITECTURE-NOTES.md) — the structure is ready, the content is empty.
